stories.title: The AI graveyard: a running list of projects and startups that didn’t make it
stories.simple_summary: Many AI projects have failed or disappointed people. Examples include Apple's Siri improvements and OpenAI's new app.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech workers. It shows that not every AI project succeeds, just like not every new restaurant stays open.

stories.title: Asian governments react to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s exit
stories.simple_summary: Asian governments are checking on their relationships with Nvidia after the CEO stepped down. Some want to make sure they can still buy the computer chips they need.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to government officials and large companies. Ordinary people won't notice any change.

stories.title: Jensen Huang and the decline of the visionary showman founder CEO
stories.simple_summary: The article talks about Jensen Huang, Nvidia's leader, getting applause at a big event. It discusses whether famous company founders still inspire people the way they used to.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech fans. It doesn't affect your daily life or business.

stories.title: New awards show celebrates AI music and its creators
stories.simple_summary: A new awards show is recognizing music made with AI and the people who created it.
stories.why_it_matters: If you make music or care about music, this shows AI tools are becoming more normal in that world. Otherwise, it's just entertainment news.

stories.title: The Nvidia Scandal Is Heightening America's AI Rivalry With China Ahead of Trump's Visit
stories.simple_summary: There is worry that Nvidia chips meant to be blocked from China may have reached there anyway. This is part of a bigger competition between America and China over AI technology.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to government policy makers. It doesn't directly affect your business or shopping.

stories.title: US officials raise alarm over restricted Nvidia AI chips reaching China
stories.simple_summary: US officials are concerned that special computer chips Nvidia was not supposed to sell to China have somehow gotten there.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to government officials and large tech companies. It won't change anything you do.

stories.title: Amazon has a plan to index the world’s online shopping data
stories.simple_summary: Amazon is building a database of every product sold anywhere online, even items Amazon doesn't sell itself. They plan to show this information on their website to keep shoppers from leaving.
stories.why_it_matters: If you shop online, Amazon is trying to become the one place you look before buying anything. This could mean you see more items when you start on Amazon, but also that Amazon gets more power in online shopping.

stories.title: FAA investigating whether new AI technology contributed to nationwide ground stop
stories.simple_summary: The FAA is looking into whether new AI technology had something to do with a nationwide flight ground stop.
stories.why_it_matters: If you travel by airplane, this matters because it checks whether new AI is safe enough to use in flying systems. An official investigation means they're being careful before trusting AI with something important.

stories.title: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia's boss Jensen Huang has stepped down. Now smaller AI companies that got money from Nvidia are worried they won't get as much funding in the future.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters mainly to investors and AI startup owners. If you run a regular small business, it doesn't affect you.

stories.title: ChatGPT Wallet lets OpenAI’s Dots agents make purchases for you
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI is letting its ChatGPT AI agents spend money on your behalf if you link a credit card. Only paying subscribers can use this right now.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use ChatGPT and decide to give it access to your card, you're letting AI make purchases for you. Be careful, because you're responsible for what it buys. Most people don't need this feature.

stories.title: AI agent startup LangChain hits $3B valuation
stories.simple_summary: A company called LangChain that helps other companies build AI tools reached a very high value in funding. They say 7,000 companies use their product.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech companies building AI. There's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: Export-banned Nvidia chips are behind China’s most powerful AI models — uh-oh, Jensen!
stories.simple_summary: Researchers found that China's most advanced AI systems were built using Nvidia computer chips that America is supposed to keep from selling to China.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to government officials concerned about keeping up in AI competition with China. It doesn't change what AI tools you can use or buy.
